name: whisper-stage-direction
title: Whisper Stage Direction
description: Play-script typography where italic stage directions sit inset from the speech, character names are tracked caps on their own line, and clicking a direction highlights the affected character's next line — theatre markup made navigable.
designRules:
# Design System

Genre: Editorial
Macrostructure: Stack
Density: Medium
Shape: Sharp
Motion: None
Typography: Humanist
Color: Monochrome

## Rules

- Click Highlight Cast: the interaction model is part of the design, not an add-on.
- Reduced motion replaces animation with a state change; nothing is hidden behind motion.
- The component composes through `cn` and never hardcodes colours.

## Avoid

- Reskinning this resource and republishing it under a new name.
- Adding shadows or radii that contradict its shape language.
